definitions.explanation: A member of the police force.

examples.english: I asked a police officer for directions.

examples.japanese: {警官|けいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is a police officer at the police box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{警官|けいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He wants to become a police officer.

examples.japanese: {警官|けいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{警官|けいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: There was an accident, so a police officer came and investigated.

notes:
{警官|けいかん} is a neutral-to-formal term for police officer, commonly used in news reports and everyday adult conversation.

REGISTER DIFFERENCES:
- ⟦おまわりさん→おまわりさん：02896_omawarisan⟧: friendly, used by children and in casual speech
- {警官|けいかん}: neutral, used in everyday adult speech and news
- ⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧: official/formal title, used in legal and administrative contexts

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧: the police (organization)
- ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧: detective

PLACES:
- ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧: police box (small neighborhood station)
- ⟦{警察署|けいさつしょ}→警察署：01078_keisatsusho⟧: police station (full-size)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {警官|けいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{職務質問|しょくむしつもん}→職務質問：15010_shokumushitsumon⟧される: to be questioned by police
- {警官|けいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call the police
